cases.mechanism_detail: A maternally inherited ~2.8-kb SVA in intron 1 of GNAS-AS1 carries a polyadenylation signal that blunts run-through transcription from the exon H/AS region (and GNAS-AS1 in the other direction), preventing establishment of maternal GNAS imprints and causing broad loss of methylation at maternal DMRs.
cases.quote: Furthermore, a retrotransposon insertion within GNAS, identified in a PHP1B kindred, impairs bidirectionally run-through transcription, thus perturbing GNAS methylation.
